verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's EB-1A guide says premium processing gives a 15-business-day decision but does not change the evidentiary standard applied, which explains part of what it does and does not do. The pricing page separately notes premium processing fees of around $3K are not included in its flat fee. Coverage is limited to one classification and is spread across a blog post and a pricing footnote rather than a dedicated explanation. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of Form I-907, a list of which classifications qualify beyond EB-1A, and an explanation of which later stages premium processing does not speed up (e.g., adjustment of status or consular steps).
